components.name: Primary Action Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4F46E5; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); transition: all 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338CA; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); background: #312E81; }

narrative.overview: TutorGate's visual identity unites the rigorous academic discipline of India’s top coaching ecosystems with the intellectual sophistication and luminous clarity of Anthropic Claude frontier AI. Every screen balances two distinct rhythms: The Crisp Daylight Workspace (clear, airy surfaces for document scanning and administration) and The Frontier Intelligence Chamber (focused obsidian surfaces for live AI streaming and prompt caching).
keyCharacteristics: Academic Authority: Razor-sharp typography and official CBSE/ICSE blueprint structures
Luminous Precision: Intelligent chromatic accents in Academic Indigo, Surya Amber, and Veracity Emerald
Indian Cultural Nuance: Native integration of WhatsApp messaging cards and UPI deep-links
Frontier AI Legitimacy: Prominent, tasteful Anthropic Claude credentials and agent indicators

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: Every screen must contain exactly one dominant primary action in Academic Indigo (#4F46E5). Subsidiary actions must use secondary outlined or semantic button variants.

rules.name: The Real-Money Emerald Rule
rules.body: Green (#10B981 or #25D366) is reserved strictly for financial reconciliation, attendance confirmation, and verified STEM proofs.

rules.name: The Board Blueprint Legibility Rule
rules.body: Question papers and worksheet previews must never drop below 14px body size with 1.6 line height.

rules.name: The Hairline Boundary Rule
rules.body: No card or floating panel may rely on shadow alone for boundary definition. Every elevated element must carry a crisp 1px border.

dos: Do maintain strict 16px horizontal screen padding on mobile devices and 24px on desktop.
Do render all currency figures in Indian Rupee format with standard commas (₹3,000) and tabular figures.
Do provide both Student Printable Copy and Teacher Marking Scheme views whenever showing generated test papers.
Do keep tap targets at a minimum of 44px x 44px on mobile devices for WhatsApp reminder and attendance buttons.
donts: Don't use muddy drop-shadows with blur radius > 24px or opacity > 10%.
Don't display mathematical formulas or question numbers with proportional fonts where subscripts and superscripts collide.
Don't hide WhatsApp or UPI functionality behind complex sub-menus; Indian home tutors demand 1-tap mobile workflows.
Don't invent artificial Silicon Valley jargon; speak directly to Indian tutoring realities (CBSE, ICSE, Class 10, RD Sharma, UPI, WhatsApp).
